comment: The implementations of ordered-json, the one source of its language set and of their folders, which the shared verifier (scripts/registry.mts) reads too, and the units that each holds: the official examples as a suite, the package tests of each implementation as feature units, each bound to the native test that runs it, and the public API. The verifier of scripts/, the comparator, compares the outputs of every implementation on the shared cases.

profiles.name: no-rust
profiles.reason: Rust values have no public constructor and no invalid state, Rust returns members and items as shared references, and Rust has no host JSON encoder in its standard library, so the three cases of those properties have no Rust form

profiles.name: no-php
profiles.reason: PHP has no form of these cases: its strings are byte strings, so the PHP API and the extension take one string input and no separate UTF-8 byte input, and its arrays key their members by string or by integer, the decimal string of a numeric key, so no object key can be other than a string

profiles.name: duplicates
profiles.reason: the duplicate-key rejection is a binding extension of JavaScript, Rust, PHP and Python; Go has none

profiles.name: go
profiles.reason: Marshal and ParseBytesBorrowed are binding extensions of Go

profiles.name: rust
profiles.reason: the serde module is a binding extension of Rust

profiles.name: php-extension
profiles.reason: the extension is the native backend of the PHP package: its scanner, hydration and compact functions and their descriptors exist only there

profiles.name: api
profiles.reason: the PHP extension is the native backend of the PHP package: its public API is its scanner, hydration and compact functions, and the Value API of PHP comes from the PHP package

profiles.name: typed
profiles.reason: Rust and Go return members as a typed ordered map, name the kinds with an enumeration and carry the message of a parse error as a field; JavaScript, PHP and Python return host mappings, name the kinds with strings and keep the message in the host exception

profiles.name: utf16-text
profiles.reason: JavaScript and Python strings can hold an unpaired surrogate: text input can contain one, which the parser rejects, and string access returns one; Rust and Go strings are UTF-8 and PHP strings are bytes, which hold none
